advancedArguments.name: employeeNumber
advancedArguments.description: The subordinate's employee number, e.g. 000013. Either employeeNumber or employeeName must be provided.

raw.description: The subordinate's employee number, e.g. 000013. Either employeeNumber or employeeName must be provided.

advancedArguments.name: employeeName
advancedArguments.description: The subordinate's name (full or partial). Either employeeNumber or employeeName must be provided.

raw.description: The subordinate's name (full or partial). Either employeeNumber or employeeName must be provided.

advancedArguments.name: date
advancedArguments.description: Date to add/check manual in and out for, in the format returned by the dateFormat tool (DD/MM/YYYY, or MM/DD/YYYY for en-US). Ask the user for this if not provided.

raw.description: Date to add/check manual in and out for, in the format returned by the dateFormat tool (DD/MM/YYYY, or MM/DD/YYYY for en-US). Ask the user for this if not provided.

advancedArguments.name: inDate
advancedArguments.description: In date, in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. ALWAYS ask the user for this separately, alongside the Out Date - do not assume it. The tool returns the row's own date under suggested.inDate; offer that as the default and let the user confirm or change it.

raw.description: In date, in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. ALWAYS ask the user for this separately, alongside the Out Date - do not assume it. The tool returns the row's own date under suggested.inDate; offer that as the default and let the user confirm or change it.

advancedArguments.name: inTime
advancedArguments.description: In time in HH:mm 24-hour format, e.g. 08:30. ALWAYS ask the user for this together with inDate, outDate and outTime - all four are collected separately and none is inferred.

raw.description: In time in HH:mm 24-hour format, e.g. 08:30. ALWAYS ask the user for this together with inDate, outDate and outTime - all four are collected separately and none is inferred.

advancedArguments.name: outDate
advancedArguments.description: Out date, in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. ALWAYS ask the user for this separately, alongside the In Date - never decide it yourself. An Out Date on the day AFTER the In Date is normal - many shifts end after midnight - and the Out time is then earlier on the clock than the In time, which is correct and must never be questioned or rejected. The tool reports whether this shift can end on the following day as current.shiftCanEndNextDay, and returns the row's own date under suggested.outDate; offer that as the default and let the user confirm or change it.

raw.description: Out date, in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. ALWAYS ask the user for this separately, alongside the In Date - never decide it yourself. An Out Date on the day AFTER the In Date is normal - many shifts end after midnight - and the Out time is then earlier on the clock than the In time, which is correct and must never be questioned or rejected. The tool reports whether this shift can end on the following day as current.shiftCanEndNextDay, and returns the row's own date under suggested.outDate; offer that as the default and let the user confirm or change it.

advancedArguments.name: outTime
advancedArguments.description: Out time in HH:mm 24-hour format, e.g. 17:30. ALWAYS ask the user for this together with inDate, inTime and outDate. An Out Date on the day AFTER the In Date is normal - many shifts end after midnight - and the Out time is then earlier on the clock than the In time, which is correct and must never be questioned or rejected. Check it against outDate, not against inTime.

raw.description: Out time in HH:mm 24-hour format, e.g. 17:30. ALWAYS ask the user for this together with inDate, inTime and outDate. An Out Date on the day AFTER the In Date is normal - many shifts end after midnight - and the Out time is then earlier on the clock than the In time, which is correct and must never be questioned or rejected. Check it against outDate, not against inTime.

advancedArguments.name: reason
advancedArguments.description: Reason/comment explaining why the manual in and out is being added. Always required before submission. No need reason for breakInTime and breakOutTime.

raw.description: Reason/comment explaining why the manual in and out is being added. Always required before submission. No need reason for breakInTime and breakOutTime.

advancedArguments.name: confirmed
advancedArguments.description: Set to true only after the user has reviewed the preview and explicitly confirmed the data is correct. Set to false (or omit) to just preview/validate without submitting.

raw.description: Set to true only after the user has reviewed the preview and explicitly confirmed the data is correct. Set to false (or omit) to just preview/validate without submitting.

advancedArguments.name: breakInTime
advancedArguments.description: Optional break in time in HH:mm 24-hour format. Break times are not mandatory - add them only if the user wants to. If given, breakOutTime must be given too. A break after midnight is fine on a shift whose period reaches there.

raw.description: Optional break in time in HH:mm 24-hour format. Break times are not mandatory - add them only if the user wants to. If given, breakOutTime must be given too. A break after midnight is fine on a shift whose period reaches there.

advancedArguments.name: breakOutTime
advancedArguments.description: Optional break out time in HH:mm 24-hour format. Break times are not mandatory - add them only if the user wants to. If given, breakInTime must be given too. A break after midnight is fine on a shift whose period reaches there.

raw.description: Optional break out time in HH:mm 24-hour format. Break times are not mandatory - add them only if the user wants to. If given, breakInTime must be given too. A break after midnight is fine on a shift whose period reaches there.

advancedArguments.name: rosterGroup
advancedArguments.description: Optional roster group id for GetRostersByGroupId. Leave it out: the tool reads the group off the team page's own roster list, which varies from user to user.

raw.description: Optional roster group id for GetRostersByGroupId. Leave it out: the tool reads the group off the team page's own roster list, which varies from user to user.

advancedArguments.name: rosterCode
advancedArguments.description: Optional roster code for GetGridDataByCriteria, e.g. 000058. Leave it out: the tool uses the first roster GetRostersByGroupId returns for this user's group, which is what the screen itself searches with. Takes precedence over rosterName.

raw.description: Optional roster code for GetGridDataByCriteria, e.g. 000058. Leave it out: the tool uses the first roster GetRostersByGroupId returns for this user's group, which is what the screen itself searches with. Takes precedence over rosterName.

advancedArguments.name: rosterName
advancedArguments.description: Optional roster name, e.g. 'MAK01'. Resolved to a roster code against the roster list the API returned. Ignored when rosterCode is given.

raw.description: Optional roster name, e.g. 'MAK01'. Resolved to a roster code against the roster list the API returned. Ignored when rosterCode is given.
